decision_rule.statistic: accepted checker status, quotient dimension, border coordinates
decision_rule.text: Accept a D4 seed only if projection and rebase each finish, independent C0-C3 checker accepts the rebased bytes with dimension 45615 and nonzero constant, and output hashes match. Profile the border only after acceptance. Any failed stage leaves the map unaccepted; a profile is a capacity result, not D5 evidence.
decision_rule.threshold: checker status valid_affine_slice_nonmembership, codimension 45615, variables 51, degree 4; then exact border enumeration

placement.checkpoint_detail: One causal projection, rebase, independent checker, then border profile; write-once receipts at each stage, no automatic retry or restart after partial output.

inadmissible: Calling the copied-row projection a certificate before independent C0-C3 acceptance.
Calling a border profile a D5 quotient or degree-six lower bound.
Rerunning a failed or partial stage under this one-attempt packet.
invalidation_rules: Any source or binary hash mismatch prevents execution.
A failed independent checker prevents a claim from that stage.
A counter failure prevents a solution-count comparison.
Killing1 in an over-approximating quotient is not membership evidence in the true closure.
Missing later stages remain unknown, even if an earlier stage proves a smaller lower bound.
Deferred export or missing checkpoint/certificate carries no mathematical bound.
Restore request mismatch or unverified state prevents native launch.
